SHENSHEN-SHENSHEN.title: Shenshen, Magical Girl of Light
SHENSHEN-SHENSHEN.description:
A development prototype of Shenshen, Magical Girl of Light.
Switch between girl and cat forms, each with its own owned deck. Keep your resources and powers when transforming.
Art and the starting relic are placeholders.
